greeting: Good morning, Zuhair. A big week for AI markets and a busy one on the Victorian campaign trail.

lead.headline: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO nears pricing
lead.summary: Anthropic is seeking up to $64.4 billion in a Nasdaq listing at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation, with a proposed range of $70 to $78 a share. Pricing is expected this week, with trading to follow under the ticker ANT.

stories.headline: Nature: AI-native lab runs biomolecular experiments autonomously
stories.summary: Published in Nature on 4 November, a Shanghai Jiao Tong-led team describes a multi-agent AI system that coordinates more than 20 types of lab instruments to carry out DNA synthesis and sequencing workflows. It is drawing attention as a step toward self-driving laboratories.

stories.headline: CACM November issue: Agency as a new organizing abstraction for computing
stories.summary: Communications of the ACM's November 2026 issue features a piece arguing that agency could become a central organizing concept for autonomous computational systems. The link goes to the full issue page.

stories.headline: US tightens AI chip export rules to cover remote compute access
stories.summary: A daily AI roundup reports new US export controls that now target remote access to compute, alongside a nine-country declaration on protecting AI supply chains.

stories.headline: OpenAI embeds outside evaluators and expands healthcare agents
stories.summary: OpenAI says it will place four outside safety evaluators inside its own infrastructure, and is adding healthcare computer-use features and plugins. The same roundup also covers Cloudflare's open-source browser engine for AI agents.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports earnings amid leadership questions
stories.summary: Nvidia's quarterly results are due after the US close today and are being watched closely as a bellwether for AI spending; check Nvidia's own filings for confirmed figures.

stories.headline: Man arrested over theft of Makybe Diva's Melbourne Cup trophies
stories.summary: Police arrested a 36-year-old man after a raid in Mount Waverley, and he was released pending summons. The three trophies, valued at about $3 million, taken from Flemington remain missing.

stories.headline: Woman and toddler die in Craigieburn lake
stories.summary: Paramedics could not revive the pair after they were pulled from a waterway off Aitken Boulevard around 1pm. Police are not looking for anyone else and are working to establish what happened.

stories.headline: Iran strikes Bahrain again, targeting a US base
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they sent drones at a US facility in Bahrain, while Bahrain says the attack was intercepted and accuses Tehran of a violation of its sovereignty. Talks to end the Hormuz standoff remain stalled.

stories.headline: Trump says he may meet Kim Jong Un in China
stories.summary: Among the day's headlines, Trump floated a meeting with North Korea's leader in China, while Xi and Trump are expected to meet at the APEC summit.
